📝Prompts Used:

1️⃣Formula:

“Seed [X]. Highly detailed image in [art style] of a [age] year old [gender] character. The character has [physical description: hair, eyes, skin, etc.], is wearing [outfit description], and has [facial expression]. The scene takes place in [background setting].”

2️⃣Canva Image Prompt #1
“Seed 739479027, a highly detailed consistent image in anime style. A ten year old female character. The character has green eyes, blonde hair, rose complexion, is wearing a pink frock, and is smiling. The scene takes place in a school.”

3️⃣ Canva Image Prompt #2
“Seed 739479027, a highly detailed consistent image in anime style. A ten year old female character. The character has green eyes, blonde hair, rose complexion, is wearing an orange frock, and is sad. The scene takes place in a forest.”

4️⃣ Canva Image Prompt #3
“Seed 739479027, a highly detailed consistent image in anime style. A ten year old female character. The character has green eyes, blonde hair, rose complexion, is wearing a blue frock, and is sad. The scene takes place in her bedroom and she is playing with her toys”
